title: MODERN NASHVILLE HOME - MINS TO BROADWAY
description:
This home located in the heart of the Nashville. Whether you are ready for a night out at the Downtown Broadway Honky Tonks, exploring the Gulch, visiting the beautiful Vanderbilt/Belmont university, or the Music Row/Bridgestone Area / Country music Hall of Fame etc. Just about $10 Uber ride to most top attraction in town. 
Utilizing three floors of luxurious and group-friendly living, you will have plenty of space to celebrate the weekend with your group or catch up on rest.

The space
This beautiful modern loft is situated in a prime location, close to Vanderbilt University and Downtown Nashville. Within walking distance, you’ll find Centennial Park and a variety of restaurants, bars, and coffee shops.

The loft features a spacious kitchen and a large living room. It comfortably sleeps up to 12 people with eight beds .
—**One king bed
—**Five queen beds
—**One twin bed
—**One fold-out sofa

Guest access
You’ll have access to the entire home. Before your stay, we’ll send you the access code along with the entry instructions. The host is always available to answer any questions or inquiries you may have. Thanks!

Other things to note
There’s a large dumpster located a few steps behind the alley entrance, behind the building.
